faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) suitable for Expanded mesh anode basket for electroplating?
faq.a: Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address anode system operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for expanded mesh anode requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. expanded mesh anode components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for expanded mesh anode application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Anode Basket (Expanded Mesh) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet expanded mesh anode specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
